lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p17 - Listen, repeat and count.

details: Listen, repeat and count exposes students to the numbers 1-6, models correct pronunciation, and practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pronunciation, and confident counting.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p17 - 3. Count, trace and match.

details: Count, trace and match reviews counting and the numbers 1-6 while reviewing the target language of the unit. It helps students practise counting and strengthens number-sound recognition.

Look for correct identification of the parts of the face, accurate counting of them, correct identification of the numbers, and neat lines to connect the parts of the face to the number of them that appear on the monster.
